_note: Jung's own words for the three practice tools: the method (amplification, not free association), the dream as compensation, and synchronicity with the run of chance it must be told from. Quotations name only their work and words; `npm run practice` places each in the read-only corpus. `para` is the ¶ the vault's concept notes give; where the corpus marker disagrees the pdf page alone is cited.

method.quote: This method of amplification is an expansion, a conscious enrichment. I make the dreamer focus his interest on the image
This must not be confounded with free association, in which we glide from one association to another, without regard to the initial idea

portrait.quote: the dream is a spontaneous self-portrayal, in symbolic form, of the actual situation in the unconscious

compensation.quote: As a rule the meaning of a dream is compensatory to the conscious attitude, i.e., it adds to the latter what was lacking in it
in my experience the vast majority of dreams are compensatory

definition.quote: Synchronicity therefore means the simultaneous occurrence of a certain psychic state with one or more external events which appear as meaningful parallels to the momentary subjective state

factors.quote: An unconscious image comes into consciousness either directly (i.e., literally) or indirectly (symbolized or suggested) in the form of a dream, idea, or premonition
An objective situation coincides with this content

series.quote: Occasionally there is a trebling or even more, so that Kammerer
In the majority of such cases there is not even the remotest probability of a causal connection between the coinciding events
Kammerer's factual material contains nothing but runs of chance whose only "law" is probability
